6.2.1.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the first member preserves its own original accent.

6.2.2.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the first member preserves its original accent when it is a word - 1. meaning 'a resemblance' or 2. an Instrumental or 3. a Locative or 4. a word with which the second member is compared or 5. an indeclinable or 6. an Accusative or 7. a Future Passive Participle

6.2.3.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when a word denoting colour is compounded with another colour denoting word but not so when it is the word एत।

6.2.4.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second term is गाध or लवण and the compound expresses 'a measure or mass'.

6.2.5.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the word दायद् as its second member, the first member denoting inheritance preserves its original accent.

6.2.6.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास having the words चिर or कृच्छ्र as its second member, the first member, when it denotes that which experiences an obstacle, preserves its original accent.

6.2.7.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पद denoting 'a pretext'.

6.2.8.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word निवात in the sense of 'a protection from wind'.

6.2.9.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word शारद having any other sense than that of 'autumnal'.

6.2.10.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word अध्वर्यु or कषाय denoting a genus.

6.2.11.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word सदृश or प्रतिरूप expressing resemblance with someone or something.

6.2.12.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) denoting 'measure or quantity'.

6.2.13.v: Before the word वाणिज 'a trader' the first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its accent when it is a word specifying the place wither one has to go or the ware in which one deals.

6.2.14.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the words 1. मात्रा 2. उपज्ञा 3. उपक्रम and 4. छाया when these words appear as neuter.

6.2.15.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'to feel delight' or 'is good'.

6.2.16.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when its second term is सुख or प्रिय and the sense is 'agreeable to one' or 'desired'.

6.2.17.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it denotes a thing possessed and when its second term is स्वामिन्।

6.2.18.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it ends in पति and means 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.19.v: The words भू , वाक् , चित् and दिधिषू however do not preserve their original accent in तत्-पुरुष समास when coming before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.20.v: The word भुवन may optionally keep its accent in a तत्-पुरुष समास before the word पति denoting 'master' or 'lord'.

6.2.21.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent before words आशङ्क , आबाध and नेदीयस् , when it treats about a supposition.

6.2.22.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is the word पूर्व and the sense is 'this had been lately…'.

6.2.23.v: The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when the second member is 1. सविध 2. सनीड 3. समर्याद 4. सवेश and 5. सदेश in the sense of 'what can be found in the vicinity thereof'.

6.2.24.v: The words विस्पष्ट etc. preserve their accent when followed by an adjective word in a compound.

6.2.25.v: In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of a भाव (verbal noun) preserves its original accent before the adjective forms built from श्र -- प्रशस्यस्य श्रः [[5.3.60]], ज्य -- ज्य च [[5.3.61]], अवम and कन् -- युवाल्पयोः कनन्यतरस्याम् [[5.3.64]], and before a form built from the word पाप।

6.2.26.v: In a कर्मधारय समास the first member consisting of the word कुमार preserves it original accent.

6.2.27.v: In a कर्मधारय समास of कुमार followed by प्रत्येनस् the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of कुमार।

6.2.28.v: The first syllable of कुमार is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) when the second member is a word denoting 'the name of a horde'.

6.2.29.v: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member preserves its original accent before a stem ending in a simple vowel with the exception of अ (इक्) before a word denoting time, as well as before 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

6.2.30.v: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the word बहु may optionally preserve its accent when followed by an इक्-ending stem or by a time-word or by 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

6.2.31.v: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member may optionally preserve its accent when followed by the words दिष्टि and वितस्ति।as its second members.

6.2.32.v: When a word ending in the Locative -7th case does not denote time preserves its original accent when followed by 1. सिद्ध 2. शुष्क 3. पक्व and 4. बन्ध in a compound.

6.2.33.v: The particles 1. परि 2. प्रति 3. उप and 4. अप preserve their accent before that word which specifies an exclusion or a portion of day and night (in an अव्ययीभाव समास also).

6.2.34.v: The first member of a द्वन्द समास formed of names denoting the क्षत्रिय (warrior) clans in the plural number retains its original accent when the warrior belongs to the clan of अन्धक or वृष्णि।

6.2.35.v: The numeral word standing as the first member of a द्वन्द समास , preserves its accent.

6.2.36.v: When words denoting scholars are named after their teachers and are compounded into a द्वन्द समास the first member retains its accent.

6.2.37.v: Also in the द्वन्द समास-s कार्तकौजप etc. the first members retain their accent.

6.2.38.v: The word महत् (महा) retains its accent before the following - 1. व्रीहि 2. अपराह्ण 3. गृष्टि 4. इष्वास 5. जाबाल 6. भार 7. भारत 8. हैलिहिल 9. रौरव and 10. प्रवृद्धे।

6.2.39.v: The words महत् and क्षुल्लक retain their accent before the word वैश्वदेव।

6.2.40.v: The word उष्ट्र retains its accent before सादि and वामि।

6.2.41.v: The word गो retains its accent before 1. साद 2. सादि and 3. सारथि।

6.2.42.v: The first member retains its accent in the following - 1. कुरु-गार्हपत 2. रिक्त-गुरु 3. असूत-जरती 4. अश्लील-दृढ-रूपा 5. पारे-वडवा 6. तैतिल-कद्रूः 7. पण्य-कम्बलः and 8. दासीभार etc.

6.2.43.v: A word in the Dative -4th Case as the first member retains its accent when the second member expresses that which is suited to become the former.

6.2.44.v: Before the word अर्थ the first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent.

6.2.45.v: The first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent before a Past Participle in क्त।

6.2.46.v: Before the Past Participle in क्त the first member when it itself is not a Past Participle, retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास ।

6.2.47.v: Before the Past Participle in क्त , a word ending in the Accusative -2nd case retains its accent when it does not mean a separation.

6.2.48.v: A word ending in the Instrumental -3rd case retains its accent before the Past Participle in क्त when it has a Passive meaning.

6.2.49.v: A word called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], when standing immediately before a Participle in क्त having a Passive significance, retains its accent.

6.2.50.v: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before (a word formed by) a कृत्-affix beginning with त् which as an indicatory न् but before तु।

6.2.51.v: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], retains its original accent before an Infinitive in तवै -- कृत्यार्थे तवैकेन्केन्यत्वनः [[3.4.14]], but whereby simultaneously the final has the acute as well.

6.2.52.v: An immediately preceding गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], not ending in इ or उ retains its accent before an affix having a व् follows.

6.2.53.v: The गति-s नि and अधि however retain their original accent before अञ्च् when the affix व् follows.

6.2.54.v: The word ईषत् when the first member of a compound may optionally preserve its original accent.

6.2.55.v: The first member denoting the quantity of gold retains optionally its original accent before the word धन।

6.2.56.v: The word प्रथम when first in a compound optionally retains its original accent when meaning 'a novice'.

6.2.57.v: The words कतर and कतम when as first member of a compound optionally retain their original accent in a कर्मधारय समास।

6.2.58.v: The word आर्य optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।

6.2.59.v: The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent in a कर्मधारय समास before the words ब्राह्मण and कुमार।

6.2.60.v: The word राजन् ending in Genitive 6th-Case optionally retains its original accent before the word प्रत्येनस्।

6.2.61.v: A word having the sense of 'always' optionally retains its original accent before a Past Participle in क्त ।

6.2.62.v: The word ग्राम when first member of a compound optionally retains its original accent before a word denoting 'a professional man or artisan'.

6.2.63.v: The word राजन् optionally retains its original accent after a profession-denoting noun when praise is expressed.

6.2.64.v: In the following up to -- न भूताधिकसंजीवमद्राश्मकज्जलम् [[6.2.91]], inclusive, the phrase 'the first syllable in -(the word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case) has the acute accent (उदात्त)' is always to be supplied.

6.2.65.v: If the first member of a compound is in the Locative -7th case or denoting the name of the Receiver of Tax, has acutely accented (उदात्त) first syllable, when the second member is a word denoting 'what is lawful', but not when it is हरण।

6.2.66.v: The first member of a compound has acute on the first syllable when the second member denotes that by whom the things denoted by the first are regulated or kept in order.

6.2.67.v: The acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable is optional when the word अध्यक्ष follows.

6.2.68.v: The word पाप is optionally acutely accented (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by a word denoting a professional man.

6.2.69.v: The first syllable of the first member of a compound is acutely accented (उदात्त) before a गोत्र (Patronymic) name or a Scholar-name and also before माणव and ब्राह्मण when a reproach is meant.

6.2.70.v: The first syllable of the word preceding मैरेय gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when it denotes the ingredient of the same.

6.2.71.v: A word denoting food gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when before a word which denotes a repository suited to contain that.

6.2.72.v: A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before गो , बिडाल , सिंह and सैन्धव।

6.2.73.v: A word denoting the object of comparison gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the second member is a word ending in the affix अक and the compound expresses a calling by which one gets his living.

6.2.74.v: A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in affix अक and which denotes the sport of the Eastern people, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.75.v: A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in the कृत् -affix अण् and which denotes a functionary, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.76.v: And when such a compound ending in अण् -affix denotes the name of a professional man, but not when the second term कार(derived from कृञ्), the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the first syllable of the first word.

6.2.77.v: Also when such an उपपद compound ending in अण् -affix denotes a Name, the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable but not when the second term is कार।

6.2.78.v: The words 1. गो 2. तन्ति and 3. यव get the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by पाल।

6.2.79.v: A compound ending in कृत् -affix णिनि (इन्) has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable of the first member.

6.2.80.v: When the first member of a compound expresses that with which resemblance is denoted then it has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before a word formed by णिनि (इन्) affix, only then, when such latter word is radical without any preposition and means 'giving out a definite sound like so and so'.

6.2.81.v: The compounds युक्तारोहिन् etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.82.v: When the first member is a word ending in a long vowel or is 1. काश 2. तुष 3. भ्राष्ट्र 4. वट and is followed by ज , the acutely accented (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable.

6.2.83.v: In a word consisting of more than two syllables followed by ज , the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before the last.

6.2.84.v: Before ग्राम the first syllable of the first member as acute accent (उदात्त) when thereby inhabitants are not meant.

6.2.85.v: The first member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by घोषा etc.

6.2.86.v: The words छात्रि etc. get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when followed by the word शाला।

6.2.87.v: The first member which has not a वृद्धि in the first syllable or which is not कर्की etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before प्रस्थ।

6.2.88.v: The first syllable of माला etc. gets the acute accent (उदात्त) when प्रस्थ follows.

6.2.89.v: The first member has an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable before the word नगर but not when it is the word महत् or नव , nor when it refers to a city in the lands of the Northern People.

6.2.90.v: A word of two or three syllables ending in a अ or आ (with the exception of महा and नव) standing before the word अर्म has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.91.v: The following words do not get acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when standing before अर्म etc. - 1. भूत 2. अधिक 3. संजीव 4. मद्र 5. अश्मन् and 6. कञ्जल।

6.2.92.v: In the following sūtras up to निष्ठोपसर्गपूर्वमन्यतरस्याम् [[6.2.110]], inclusive, is to be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable in a word standing in the Nominative 1st-Case has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.93.v: The acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final of the word सर्व standing as the first member before an attributive word in the sense 'whole, through and through'.

6.2.94.v: The last syllable of the first member before गिरि and निकाय has the acute accent (उदात्त) when the compound is a Name.

6.2.95.v: The last syllable of the first member get the acute accent (उदात्त) when the word कुमारी follows, the compound denoting age.

6.2.96.v: Before the word उदक when the compound denotes a mixture, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.97.v: Before a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound), when the compound denotes a sacrifice, the last syllable of the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.98.v: Before the word सभा when it is exhibited as Neuter, the first member of the compound gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.99.v: Before the word पुर , when the compound denotes a city of the Eastern People, the final of the final of the first member as the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.100.v: When the words अरिष्ट and गौड stand first, the first member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before the word पुर।

6.2.101.v: But when the words 1. हास्तिन 2. फलक and 3. मार्देय precede पुर , the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on their final.

6.2.102.v: The words 1. कुसूल 2. कूप 3. कुम्भ and 4. शाला have the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable before the word बिल।

6.2.103.v: Words expressing (in space of time) have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when followed by a word denoting a village or a country or a narrative before the word चानराट।

6.2.104.v: The direction denoting words have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, before the names of scholars when such names derived from those of their teachers.

6.2.105.v: Words denoting direction and the word सर्व have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final before a word which takes वृद्धि in the first syllable of the second term by सुसर्वार्धाज्जनपदस्य [[7.3.12]].

6.2.106.v: The word विश्व has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, being first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , when it is a Name.

6.2.107.v: The first member in a बहुव्रीहि समास , before the words 1. उदर 2. अश्व and 3. इषु , gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the final syllable when the compound denotes a Name.

6.2.108.v: A word before 1. उदर 2. अश्व and 3. इषु in a बहुव्रीहि समास gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final, when reproach is meant.

6.2.109.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास having the word बन्धु as its second member, the first member ending in the feminine affix ई (नदी word) has the ac on its final syllable.

6.2.110.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास a Participle in a क्त preceded by a preposition, standing as the first member of the compound has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.111.v: In the following sūtras up to कुण्डं वनम् [[6.2.136]], inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'the first syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.112.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word कर्ण standing as second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when it is preceded by a word denoting colour or mark.

6.2.113.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the second member कर्ण has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when the compound denotes a Name or Resemblance.

6.2.114.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास expressing a Name or comparison the second members 1. कण्ठ 2. पृष्ठ 3. ग्रीवा and 4. जङ्घा have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.115.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास denoting age (as well as a Name or a Resemblance), the second member शृङ्ग gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.116.v: After a Negative Particle, in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of 1. जर 2. मर 3. मित्र and 4. मृत।

6.2.117.v: After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास a stem ending in मन् and अस् with the exception of लोमन् and उषस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.118.v: After the adjective सु in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of क्रतु etc.

6.2.119.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) a word of two syllables with acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by सु gets acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.120.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after सु the words वीर and वीर्य have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.121.v: In an अव्ययीभाव समास the following second terms have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कूल 2. तीर 3. तूल 4. मूल 5. शाला 6. अक्ष and 7. सम।

6.2.122.v: In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the following second members get acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable - 1. कंस 2. मन्थ 3. शूर्प 3. पाय्य and 4. काण्ड।

6.2.123.v: The word शाला at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास when exhibited in the Neuter has acute on the first syllable.

6.2.124.v: In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of the second member.

6.2.125.v: In a Neuter तत्-पुरुष समास ending in कन्था the first syllable of चिहण etc. have the acute accent (उदात्त).

6.2.126.v: The words 1. चेल 2. खेट 3. कटुक and 4. काण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when a reproach is meant.

6.2.127.v: The word चीर at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when something is compared with it.

6.2.128.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास ending in 1. पलल 2. सूप and 3. शाक the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the first syllable of these when the compound denotes a food mixed or seasoned with something.

6.2.129.v: The words 1. कूल 2. सूद 3. स्थल and 4. कर्ष have acute accent (उदात्त) on their first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting a Name.

6.2.130.v: The word राज्यम् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास which is not a कर्मधारय समास ।

6.2.131.v: At the end of a non-कर्मधारय तत्-पुरुष समास the words वर्ग्य etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.132.v: The word पुत्र coming after a Masculine noun in a तत्-पुरुष समास has a acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.133.v: The word पुत्र does not have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceded by a word which falls under the category of teachers, kings, priests, wife's relations and agnates and cognates.

6.2.134.v: The words चूर्ण etc. in a तत्-पुरुष समास have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable when preceding word ends in a Genitive 6th-Case and does not denote a living being.

6.2.135.v: The six words - 1. काण्ड 2. चीर 3. पलल 4. सूप 5. शाक and 6. कूल of sūtras [[6.2.126]]-129 preceded by a non-living Genitive 6th-Case word have acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.136.v: The word कुण्ड at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास denoting 'a wood or forest' has acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

6.2.137.v: The word भगाल at the end of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent.

6.2.138.v: After शिति , a word retains in a बहुव्रीहि समास its original accent when it is always of not more than two syllables with the exception of भसद्.।

6.2.139.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास a word ending in a कृत् affix preserves its original accent when preceded by an indeclinable called गति -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]], or a noun standing in intimate relation to a verb (कारक) or any word which gives occasion for compounding (उपपद -- तत्रोपपदं सप्तमीस्थम् [[3.1.92]])

6.2.140.v: In वनस्पति etc. both members of the compound preserve their original accent simultaneously.

6.2.141.v: In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both the members retain their original accent.

6.2.142.v: In a द्वन्द compound of the Names of Divinities, both members of the compound simultaneously do not retain their accent when the first syllable of the second word is अनुदात्त with the exception of 1.पृथिवी 2. रुद्र 3. पूष and 4. मन्थिन्।

6.2.143.v: In the following sūtras up to the end of this chapter should always be supplied the phrase 'the last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त)'.

6.2.144.v: The last syllable of the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) in the verbal nouns ending in 1. थ 2. अथ 3. घञ् 4. क्त 5. अच् 6. अप् 7. इत्र and 8. क when preceded by a गति , a कारक or an उपपद -- गतिकारकोपपदात् कृत् [[6.2.139]]

6.2.145.v: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when it is preceded by सु or by a word with which the second member is compared.

6.2.146.v: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when preceded by a गति or a कारक or an उपपद if the compound denotes a Name, but not in आचित etc.

6.2.147.v: The word प्रवृद्ध etc. ending in क्त have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.148.v: The final of Part Participles दत्त and श्रुत alone have the acute accent (उदात्त) in a compound denoting a Name and a Benediction, the preceding word being a word standing in close relation to an action (कारक)।

6.2.149.v: The Participle in क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound denotes 'done by one in such a condition'.

6.2.150.v: After a कारक as mentioned in कारकाद्दत्तश्रुतयोरेवाशिषि [[6.2.148]], the second member ending in the affix अन and denoting an action in the Abstract or the object (i.e. having the senses of Passive Adjective), has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.151.v: The words ending in मन् or क्तिन् affixes and the words 1. व्याख्यान 2. शयन 3. आसन 4. स्थान and 5. क्रीत as well as याजक etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when at the end of a compound preceded by कारक word.

6.2.152.v: The word पुण्य has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a Noun in the Locative -7th case.

6.2.153.v: The acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of words having the sense of ऊन and of कलह when they are second members in a compound, preceded by a term in the Instrumental -3rd case.

6.2.154.v: The word मिश्र has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after an Instrumental -3rd case when it is not joined with any Preposition and does not mean a 'compact or alliance'.

6.2.155.v: The words formed with the तद्धित affixes denoting 'fitted for that' -- सम्पादिनि [[5.1.99]], 'deserving that' -- तद् अर्हति [[5.1.63]], 'good for that' -- तस्मै हितम् [[5.1.5]], 'capable to effect that' -- तस्मै प्रभवति संतापादिभ्यः [[5.1.101]], have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the Negative Particle नञ् , when it makes a negation with regard to the above mentioned attributes.

6.2.156.v: The words formed with the तद्धित affixes य and यत् when not denoting 'useful for that' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable after the particle नञ् negating the attribute.

6.2.157.v: A word formed with the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by the particle नञ् has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the meaning is 'not capable'.

6.2.158.v: A word formed by the कृत् affixes अच् and क preceded by a Negative Particle have an acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when one abuses somebody by that word.

6.2.159.v: When abuse is meant, a word preceded by नञ् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in denoting a Name.

6.2.160.v: After the Negative Particle, the words formed by the कृत्य affixes -- कृत्याः प्राङ् ण्वुलः [[3.1.95]], by उक and इष्णुच् and the words चारु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.161.v: After the negative particle, the final of the following is optionally acute accent (उदात्त) - a word formed with the affix तृन् and the words 1. अन्न 2. तीक्ष्ण and 3. शुचि।

6.2.162.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after the words इदम् , एतद् and तद् the last syllable of प्रथम and of a proper ordinal numeral as the acute accent (उदात्त) when the number of times of an action is meant.

6.2.163.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after a numeral the word स्तन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.164.v: Optionally so, in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the स्तन after a numeral has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.165.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in मित्र and अजिन the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the last syllable when the compound denotes a Name.

6.2.166.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in अन्तर the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final after a word which denotes 'that which lies between'.

6.2.167.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final when the second member is मुख 'mouth' i.e. the actual bodily part of an animal and not used metaphorically.

6.2.168.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on such मुख 'mouth' denoting a real mouth when it comes after an indeclinable and a name of a direction or after 1. गो 2. महत् 3. स्थूल 4. मुष्टि 5. पृथु and 6. वत्स।

6.2.169.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the word मुख denoting 'an actual mouth' has optionally the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a participle in त or by that wherewith something is compared.

6.2.170.v: After a word denoting a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') and after a time-denoting word as well as after सुख etc. the Participle in the क्त has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a बहुव्रीहि समास but not so when the participles are 1. कृत 2. मित 3. प्रतिपन्न।

6.2.171.v: After a species (with the exception of a word for 'garment or covering') or a time-denoting word or after सुख etc. in a बहुव्रीहि समास the word जात has optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.172.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable of the compound.

6.2.173.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास formed by the negative particle नञ् or by सु and ending in the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], has acute accent (उदात्त) on the syllable preceding the affix.

6.2.174.v: When the compound ends in a light vowel the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before such last, in a बहुव्रीहि समास preceded by नञ् and सु to which the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च [[5.4.153]], is added.

6.2.175.v: A बहुव्रीहि समास with बहु has the same accent as नञ् when it denotes muchness of the object expressed by the second member.

6.2.176.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास , after बहु the acute accent (उदात्त) does not fall on the final of गुण etc. when they appear in the compound as ingredient of something else.

6.2.177.v: A word denoting a part of the body which is constant (and indispensable) with the exception of पर्शु has after a preposition in a बहुव्रीहि समास the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.178.v: After a preposition वन has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in compounds of every kind.

6.2.179.v: After अन्तर् the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of वन।

6.2.180.v: The word अन्तर् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by a preposition.

6.2.181.v: The word अन्तर् does not have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the prepositions नि and वि।

6.2.182.v: After परि a word which expresses something which has both this side and that side, as well as the word मण्डल has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.183.v: After प्र a, a word which does not denote a part of the body has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when the compound is a name.

6.2.184.v: The words निरुदकetc. Have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.185.v: The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by अभि।

6.2.186.v: The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the preposition अप्।

6.2.187.v: The words 1. स्फिग 2. पूत 3. वीणा 4. अञ्जस् 5. अध्वम् 6. कुक्षि 6. नामन् and a word denoting 'a plough' have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by the preposition अप्।

6.2.188.v: After अधि that word which denotes that thing which overlaps or stands upon has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.189.v: After अनु a word which is not the Principal as well as कनीयस् has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.190.v: After अनु the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the final of पुरुष when it means a man of whom mention was already made.

6.2.191.v: After अति , a word not formed by a कृत् affix and the word पद have acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

6.2.192.v: After नि the second member has the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable when the sense is of 'not laying down'.

6.2.193.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words अंशु etc. have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by प्रति।

6.2.194.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the words of two syllables and अजिन् have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final when preceded by उप but not when they are गौर etc.

6.2.195.v: After सु the second member has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final in a तत्-पुरुष समास when reproach is meant, in spite of the addition of सु which denotes praise.

6.2.196.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास the word उत्पुच्छ may optionally have acute accent (उदात्त) on the final.

6.2.197.v: In a बहुव्रीहि समास the words 1. पाद् 2. दत् and 3. मूर्धन् have optionally acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after द्वि and त्रि।

6.2.198.v: The word सक्थ has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final optionally when preceded by any word other than what ends in क्र।

6.2.199.v: The first syllable of the second member is diversely acutely accented (उदात्त) in the छन्दस् (Vedas).
